notes.title: Update hotfix
notes.notes: Ooops, the last update broke the launcher! Sorry, I fix~

notes.title: The spring cleaning patch part 2 : not-quite-summer edition!
notes.notes:
- Updated some UI graphics
- Adjusted some UI text to better fit text boxes
- Balanced some enemies
- Cleaned up some menu bugs

notes.title: Major UI Overhaul Phase 2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added the new buttons to odd menus that didn't have them yet
[*]Changed the text outline to better match the new aesthetic while maintaining readability
[*]Improved the tutorial interface and text placement triggers
[*]Fixed the bug where angry bats weren't attacking the cat
[*]Fixed the bug where you can get stuck on top of lazy dogs
[*]Fixed the bug where you'd get stuck in the tutorial until you quit. 
[/list]

As always, thanks a ton for playing with us! Your feedback has a very meaningful impact on where we make improvements <3

notes.title: Spring update hotfix
notes.notes: Hotfix for the last patch, just to fix some weird lil gremlins that shook out in the graphical update.

notes.title: Spring cleaning patch!
notes.notes:
Made visual improvements to most of the game UI and fonts. 

Fixed a bug where you could fall infinitely through the void if you slipped through the level geometry.

Set the stage for more UI visual overhauls.

Thanks for playing with us <3

notes.title: First post-launch patch!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] We've made some minor visual tweaks across all of the levels to make things more visually appealng in odd spots. 
[*] Fixed some bugs with portals in the business tower level. 
[*] Fixed a bug where you'd be trapped in shallow water, unable to jump away.
[/list]

[i][u][b]Added barking to the dogs[/b][/u][/i]

Thanks to everyone who bought into our early release!

We can only improve further from here. 

We're gonna keep quiet on future plans, but we will confirm they're being made!
